content: The pyridine recovered QED from 0.623 to 0.672, but LogP is still 5.02 and that is what is holding drug-likeness down - the aryl at C4 adds a whole lipophilic ring, and this molecule is carrying a cyclopentyl cap on top of it, the greasiest cap in my set. Atom 1 is the amide carbonyl and atom 22 the cyclopentane CH; the aryl swap replaced six atoms with six so the numbering is unchanged, and if I have that wrong the two atoms simply will not be bonded and the call fails harmlessly. I am going to an oxetane rather than my usual cyclopropyl. Normally cyclopropyl wins because its SA is better, but that trade assumed a molecule already inside the drug-like window; here LogP is the dominant penalty and the oxetane takes nearly two log units off where a cyclopropyl takes less than one. Cap ring size is activity-neutral, so the 0.70 should survive either way. Expected product: about 346 Da at LogP near 3.3.
